dataset: NASA GISTEMP v4 global Land-Ocean Temperature Index

report.conclusion: The pinned global anomaly series shows a positive monotonic trend over the analysis period; the exploratory endpoint sensitivity check does not overturn that pattern. This is a descriptive time-series result, not a causal attribution analysis.

limitations: A global aggregate does not represent local or regional trends.
An anomaly series alone does not identify causal attribution.
evidence.source_title: NASA GISS Surface Temperature Analysis v4 data downloads
evidence.statement: NASA GISTEMP v4 global land-ocean annual mean temperature anomalies (J-D column), relative to the 1951–1980 baseline.

limitations: A reproducibility snapshot can differ from later NASA revisions.
evidence.source_title: Pinned GISTEMP CSV snapshot and deterministic analysis
evidence.statement: SHA-256 c9ce0750ca93a8241c42fe86cd5bf54d07b28b21ae650b0ae49a206907018cd9; 146 complete annual values were analysed for 1880–2025.

limitations: The bootstrap interval quantifies sampling sensitivity under the stated residual block scheme; it does not include all measurement or structural uncertainty.
evidence.statement: Mann–Kendall tau-b=0.7347, p=3.44e-39; Sen slope=0.0812 °C/decade; the block-bootstrap OLS 95% interval is 0.0676 to 0.0980 °C/decade.

falsification_tests.method: Exploratory endpoint sensitivity: re-run Mann–Kendall and Sen-slope estimates through the year before the final ten observations.
falsification_tests.question: Does the positive trend persist after excluding 2016-2025?
falsification_tests.result_summary: For 1880–2015, Sen slope=0.0711 °C/decade and Mann–Kendall p=4.37e-33.

hypotheses.statement: The annual global land-ocean temperature anomaly series has a positive monotonic trend over the stated period.
The apparent full-period rise is solely a recent-endpoint effect and disappears when the final ten years are omitted.

limitations: One global annual series is not an independent replication across datasets.
A monotonic trend test does not explain causes or predict local impacts.
The pinned snapshot and the analysis choices should be revisited when reproducing later NASA revisions.
report.question: Did annual global GISTEMP land-ocean anomalies increase over 1880–2025?

caveats: This interval reflects the specified block-bootstrap procedure, not all sources of uncertainty.
The analysis is descriptive and does not attribute causes.
uncertainty.method: 95% circular moving-block bootstrap of detrended OLS residuals; 5-year blocks; seed 1042026; 2000 replicates

endpoint_falsification.question: Does the positive trend persist after excluding 2016-2025?

methods.interval: 95% circular moving-block bootstrap of detrended OLS residuals; 5-year blocks; seed 1042026; 2000 replicates
methods.robust_slope: Theil-Sen median of all pairwise slopes
methods.trend_test: two-sided Mann-Kendall normal approximation with tie correction
